## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it belongs in SigmaMutant's bounded
mutation-testing scope.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Full test suite passes locally
- [ ] Weak-to-strong example checked when relevant
- [ ] Deterministic artifacts and exit codes preserved
- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when relevant
- [ ] No credentials, production logs, proprietary rules, or customer data added

Describe any suite, report-schema, evaluator, provider, dependency, or trust-
boundary impact. Use the private process in `SECURITY.md` for vulnerabilities.
